2
Kristo a wɔbɔɔ no asennua mu no
1 # 1 Ko 1.17 Na me nso, anuanom, mebaa mo nkyɛn no, mamfa asɛm anaa nyansa a ɛtra soɔ mammɛka Nyankopɔn adansesɛm no. 2#Gal 6.14 Na mebɔɔ me tirim sɛ merenhwehwɛ biribiara wɔ mo hɔ, gye Yesu Kristo a wɔbɔɔ no asɛnnua mu no. 3#Aso 18.9; 2 Ko 10.1 Na me deɛ, mmerɛyɛ ne ehu ne ahopopoɔ bebree mu na me ne mo tenaeɛ. 4#1 Ko 2.1 Na me kasa ne m’asɛnka amfa nnipa nyansa adɛfɛdɛfɛ kwan so, na mmom ɛnam honhom ne tumi yikyerɛ mu, 5#Efe 1.17; 1.19; 1 Te 1.5 na mo gyidie annyina nnipa nyansa so, na mmom agyina Nyankopɔn tumi so.
Nyankopɔn nokorɛ nyansa no
6Nanso yɛka nyansa ho asɛm kyerɛ wɔn a wɔdi mu; na ɛyɛ nyansa a ɛnyɛ wiase yi deɛ, na ɛnyɛ wiase atumfoɔ a wɔbɛyi wɔn hɔ no deɛ, 7#Rom 16.25 na mmom yɛka Nyankopɔn nyansa ahuntasɛm mu, nyansa a wɔde sieeɛ a Onyankopɔn de too hɔ maa yɛn animuonyam ansa na wɔrehyɛ wiase aseɛ. 8#Luk 23.34; Yak 2.1 Deɛ wiase yi atumfoɔ mu biara anhunu, na sɛ wɔhunuiɛ a, anka wɔammɔ animuonyam Wura no asɛnnua mu, 9#Yes 64.3 na mmom sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ:
Deɛ ani nhunuiɛ, na aso nteeɛ
na ɛmmaa onipa akoma mu da ne
nnoɔma a Onyankopɔn asiesie ama wɔn a wɔdɔ no no.
10 # Mat 13.11 Na yɛn na Onyankopɔn nam Honhom so ayi akyerɛ yɛn; ɛfiri sɛ Honhom no pɛɛpɛɛ adeɛ nyinaa mu, Nyankopɔn nnoɔma a emu dɔ no nso mu. 11Na nnipa mu hwan na ɔnim deɛ ɛwɔ onipa mu, gye onipa no ara honhom a ɛwɔ ne mu? Saa ara nso na obi nnim Nyankopɔn adwene, gye Nyankopɔn honhom. 12Na yɛn deɛ, ɛnyɛ wiase honhom na yɛnyaeɛ, na mmom honhom a ɔfiri Nyankopɔn mu, na yɛahunu deɛ Onyankopɔn de adom yɛn kwa no. 13#1 Ko 2.1; 2.4 Nso deɛ yɛka no, ɛnyɛ nsɛm a wɔde nnipa nyansa kyerɛkyerɛ, na mmom deɛ Honhom no kyerɛkyerɛ na yɛde honhom adeɛ to honhom adeɛ ho. 14#1 Ko 1.23; Yoh 8.47 Na onipa a ɔnni honhom no nnye Nyankopɔn Honhom adeɛ, na ɛyɛ no nkwaseasɛm, na ɔntumi nhunu mu, ɛfiri sɛ wɔbu mu atɛn honhom mu. 15#1 Yoh 2.20 Na onipa a ɔwɔ honhom mu no deɛ, ɔbu adeɛ nyinaa atɛn, na ɔno deɛ obiara mmu no atɛn.
16 # Rom 11.34; Yes 40.13 Na hwan na wahunu Awurade adwene
a ɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ no?
Na yɛn deɛ, yɛwɔ Kristo adwene.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na me nso, anuanom, mebaa mo nkyɛn no, mamfa asɛm anaa nyansa a ɛtra soɔ mammɛka Nyankopɔn adansesɛm no. Na mebɔɔ me tirim sɛ merenhwehwɛ biribiara wɔ mo hɔ, gye Yesu Kristo a wɔbɔɔ no asɛnnua mu no. Na me deɛ, mmerɛyɛ ne ehu ne ahopopoɔ bebree mu na me ne mo tenaeɛ. Na me kasa ne m’asɛnka amfa nnipa nyansa adɛfɛdɛfɛ kwan so, na mmom ɛnam honhom ne tumi yikyerɛ mu, na mo gyidie annyina nnipa nyansa so, na mmom agyina Nyankopɔn tumi so.

Nanso yɛka nyansa ho asɛm kyerɛ wɔn a wɔdi mu; na ɛyɛ nyansa a ɛnyɛ wiase yi deɛ, na ɛnyɛ wiase atumfoɔ a wɔbɛyi wɔn hɔ no deɛ, na mmom yɛka Nyankopɔn nyansa ahuntasɛm mu, nyansa a wɔde sieeɛ a Onyankopɔn de too hɔ maa yɛn animuonyam ansa na wɔrehyɛ wiase aseɛ. Deɛ wiase yi atumfoɔ mu biara anhunu, na sɛ wɔhunuiɛ a, anka wɔammɔ animuonyam Wura no asɛnnua mu, na mmom sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ:
Deɛ ani nhunuiɛ, na aso nteeɛ
na ɛmmaa onipa akoma mu da ne
nnoɔma a Onyankopɔn asiesie ama wɔn a wɔdɔ no no.
Na yɛn na Onyankopɔn nam Honhom so ayi akyerɛ yɛn; ɛfiri sɛ Honhom no pɛɛpɛɛ adeɛ nyinaa mu, Nyankopɔn nnoɔma a emu dɔ no nso mu. Na nnipa mu hwan na ɔnim deɛ ɛwɔ onipa mu, gye onipa no ara honhom a ɛwɔ ne mu? Saa ara nso na obi nnim Nyankopɔn adwene, gye Nyankopɔn honhom. Na yɛn deɛ, ɛnyɛ wiase honhom na yɛnyaeɛ, na mmom honhom a ɔfiri Nyankopɔn mu, na yɛahunu deɛ Onyankopɔn de adom yɛn kwa no. Nso deɛ yɛka no, ɛnyɛ nsɛm a wɔde nnipa nyansa kyerɛkyerɛ, na mmom deɛ Honhom no kyerɛkyerɛ na yɛde honhom adeɛ to honhom adeɛ ho. Na onipa a ɔnni honhom no nnye Nyankopɔn Honhom adeɛ, na ɛyɛ no nkwaseasɛm, na ɔntumi nhunu mu, ɛfiri sɛ wɔbu mu atɛn honhom mu. Na onipa a ɔwɔ honhom mu no deɛ, ɔbu adeɛ nyinaa atɛn, na ɔno deɛ obiara mmu no atɛn.
Na hwan na wahunu Awurade adwene
a ɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ no?
Na yɛn deɛ, yɛwɔ Kristo adwene.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
